what: Plan lowers run_evaluate_failure retry budget although the feature only asks to resolve the Claude-tier asymmetry
scenario_or_breakage: The stated issue offers extend with Claude or document asymmetry; lowering 5 outer attempts to 3 changes recovery behavior and can stall branches that currently recover on attempts 4-5
suggested_fix: Keep _max_fix at 5 unless #2632 explicitly accepts the budget change; otherwise add the budget change to the feature/acceptance text and call out production stall-rate validation

what: Plan sends raw gh-run-logs output to CI launchers but omits SECURITY.md and redaction/trust handling
scenario_or_breakage: gh-run-logs captures unstructured failed CI logs; forwarding that file to Cursor/Codex/Claude can expose secrets or private infrastructure beyond current documented trust boundaries
suggested_fix: Update SECURITY.md and the launcher contract; require redaction or a documented private-session trust model, and add a test with token-like log content verifying the chosen behavior

what: Plan does not explicitly retire stale 5-attempt fix-loop assertions
scenario_or_breakage: The existing exhausted-loop test expects all 5 vendor attempts and 20 check runs; after _max_fix=3 and the 3-tier waterfall this assertion will fail or keep obsolete behavior pinned
suggested_fix: Update existing fix-loop tests and labels for the new 3-outer budget, or keep the old budget; include the stale assertion in the plan's test-update list
